_comment: R-B Last-Seen-Ledger vectors (concept v1.2 §5 B): SYMBOLIC presence anchors on the REAL WorldEventFeed.Append path. Zones are event-anchor identities (obj:<text> / door:<GUID> / at:<group>) - NO coordinates, NO distances, NO movement commitment. KIND is first-class: fact = the public M10b attribution law places the actor there (objective, door flip inside an open window); hypothesis = a hit inside the window proves weapon-range proximity only - consumers must never render it like a fact. Latest anchoring event wins PER HERO; nothing is ever written from absence. expect blocks recorded once via `dotnet run -- <fixtures> --record` and reviewed; the law checks live in SectionsHeroLedger.cs as hand-pinned ground truth.

cases.name: rb_hero_at_objective
cases.comment: Acceptance (a): ObjectiveChange inside Lokaku's OPEN window -> zone obj:<objective text>, kind fact (public M10b/M6s-B6 attribution places the actor there). Anchor survives the window's close - it is history, not a live-position claim.

payload.objective: Open the door to the command center.

expect.canon:
mission=vector|rb_hero_at_objective
round=2
posture=eliminate
objective=Secure the canteen.
objective_actor=Lokaku
threat=0
threatseen=0
seq=4
H|Lokaku|Lokaku|0|0|1|2|0|0
seen=Lokaku zone=obj:Secure the canteen. kind=fact seq=3 round=2
expect.ledger_text: ledger Lokaku war bei Ziel "Secure the canteen." (Runde 2, seq 3, fact)

cases.name: rb_hero_at_door
cases.comment: Acceptance (b): DoorOpen inside the open window -> zone door:<GUID>, kind fact. A flip OUTSIDE any window (seq5) anchors nobody - absence writes nothing.

expect.canon:
mission=vector|rb_hero_at_door
round=3
posture=eliminate
objective=Defeat the rebel cell.
objective_actor=
threat=0
threatseen=0
seq=5
H|Han|Han|0|0|1|2|0|0
seen=Han zone=door:d-hangar-west kind=fact seq=3 round=2
expect.ledger_text: ledger Han war bei Tuer d-hangar-west (Runde 2, seq 3, fact)

cases.name: rb_shot_is_hypothesis
cases.comment: Acceptance (c): GroupDamage inside the open window anchors the shooter at at:<group> with kind HYPOTHESIS - a hit proves weapon-range proximity, never a placed position. The kind rides in canon AND ledger_text; the objective change AFTER the window closes leaves the anchor untouched (the legacy retro channel is never mirrored into the ledger).

expect.canon:
mission=vector|rb_shot_is_hypothesis
round=3
posture=eliminate
objective=Secure the canteen.
objective_actor=Lokaku
threat=0
threatseen=0
seq=6
G|STORM|STORM|1|0|2|2|1|4|7/8|name=Stormtroopers|shot=Lokaku|4|2
H|Lokaku|Lokaku|0|0|1|2|0|0
seen=Lokaku zone=at:STORM kind=hypothesis seq=4 round=2
expect.ledger_text: ledger Lokaku war vermutlich in der Nahe von Gruppe STORM (Runde 2, seq 4, hypothesis)

cases.name: rb_spawn_in_window
cases.comment: Acceptance (d1): Spawn falls inside the open window -> SpawnedInHeroWindow (the intruder was pulled in by hero activity); the G row grows |in_window ONLY there.

round=2
posture=eliminate
objective=Defeat the rebel cell.
objective_actor=

threatseen=0
seq=4
G|GIVAN|GIVAN|1|0|1|1|2|0|1|name=Grand Inquisitor|in_window
H|Han|Han|0|0|1|2|0|0
expect.ledger_text: spawn GIVAN fiel in ein offenes Heldenfenster (Runde 2)

cases.name: rb_spawn_out_window
cases.comment: Acceptance (d2): every Spawn here is outside any window (baseline spawn, then a spawn between windows after the close) -> no marker, G row byte-identical to pre-R-B.

cases.name: rb_last_window_wins
cases.comment: Acceptance (e): two anchoring events for the SAME hero in two windows - the LATER seq wins: fact obj:Secure the canteen. (seq3) is overwritten by hypothesis at:STORM (seq5); the shot in window 2 also credits the group row (R-A column stays consistent with the ledger).

H|Lokaku|Lokaku|0|0|2|3|0|0
seen=Lokaku zone=at:STORM kind=hypothesis seq=7 round=3
expect.ledger_text: ledger Lokaku war vermutlich in der Nahe von Gruppe STORM (Runde 3, seq 7, hypothesis)

cases.name: rb_two_windows_two_heroes
cases.comment: Identity separation: Lokaku's window shot anchors LOKAKU (hypothesis at:STORM); Han's later objective change anchors HAN (fact obj:...) and leaves Lokaku's anchor untouched. 'latest wins' is per hero, never global.
